item.title: Merck Mercuriadis to Deliver Keynote at Music Tectonics Conference 2026
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest news and trends in the music industry. Today, we're talking about the upcoming Music Tectonics conference, and a very special keynote speaker. Merck Mercuriadis, the founder of Hipgnosis and now Hipgnosis Artist Partnerships, is set to take the stage on October 28th in Santa Monica, California.
Mercuriadis is a pioneer in the music industry, known for popularizing music as an asset class. He founded Hipgnosis, which was later renamed Recognition Music Group, and has now launched a new venture, Hipgnosis Artist Partnerships.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "The Music Tectonics conference, which runs from October 27th to 29th, will feature a series of panels on the intersection of music and tech. Some of the topics include the future of music licensing and royalties, the role of AI in the music industry, and how to multiply revenue, not disrupt it.
[Music transitions to a slightly more upbeat tone]
Host: "According to Dmitri Vietze, the founder of Music Tectonics, this year's conference is all about working together to create a rising tide that lifts all boats. And with Merck Mercuriadis as the keynote speaker, it's sure to be an exciting and thought-provoking event. As Mercuriadis himself said, the next decade will bring a significant value shift in the music industry, and it's going to be interesting to see what he has to say about it.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "If you're interested in attending the Music Tectonics conference, early-bird pricing is available until August 11th. You can purchase tickets now and be a part of the conversation that's shaping the future of the music industry. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll see you next time!"
